verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of outbound delivery to warehouses is a thin marketing claim that mParticle connects customer data to data warehousing solutions. The documented Warehouse Sync feature runs the opposite direction: it ingests from your warehouse into mParticle, so it does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented outbound export of raw events and profiles to named destinations (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3), user-controlled scheduling of those loads, schema/format details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control

citations.quote: data warehousing solutions with just a few clicks.
